content.en: The **Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC)** is a strategic infrastructure project aimed at creating high-capacity, high-speed railway corridors exclusively for freight trains. By separating freight traffic from passenger traffic, the Indian Railways aims to increase the average speed of goods trains, reduce transit times, and lower the overall **logistics cost** in the Indian economy. This initiative is vital for enhancing the efficiency of the **industrial sector** and supporting the 'Make in India' initiative.

By separating freight traffic from passenger traffic, the Indian Railways aims to increase the average speed of goods trains, reduce transit times, and lower the overall **logistics cost** in the Indian economy. This initiative is vital for enhancing the efficiency of the **industrial sector** and supporting the 'Make in India' initiative.
